newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh forex reserves to reach $2.2 bln.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh forex reserves to reach $2.2 bln.

text.p: Bangladesh's foreign exchange reserves are expected to rise to $2.2 billion by the end of December from the present $1.83 billion, Finance Minister S.A.M.S. Kibria said on Wednesday.

"Fortunately we have stabilised the country's foreign exchange reserves. It's now expected to rise to $2.2 billion by the middle of next year (fiscal 1997/98 beginning in July)," he told Reuters in an interview.
He blamed an outflow of one billion dollar in the previous year for the lower reserves. "Unusual rapid increase in bank credit led to import demand...and higher food imports," he said.
